dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCHC02QV02 handles prescription/receipt printing (A5 format with QR code support).

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (shinryo-hoshu) prescription printing system for JMA ORCA. Handles inpatient/outpatient prescriptions, QR code printing, insurance combination logic, and various Japanese medical fee revisions from 2002 through 2014.
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It generates printed prescription forms (A5 format) including QR code support, handling Japanese medical insurance rules, drug dispensing details, patient/insurer information, and multiple fee revision cycles. It reads prescription data and outputs formatted print records to a printer file.

notable_features: 349 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
QR code printing support (IDX-QR1, IDX-QR2 fields)
Japanese EUC/Latin-1 encoded comments with full-width characters
OCCURS clauses for insurance combination arrays
Long revision history spanning 2002-2014 with named change authors
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese comments. File is truncated at 16000 chars of 247758 bytes total (5787 lines). All four COBOL divisions present. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system distributed by JMA, typically compiled with GnuCOBOL on Linux.
